title: Vaporesso Gen Air 40 Replacement Pods 2ml - 2 Pack
description: The Vaporesso Gen Air 40 is one of the lightest 40W vape pod kits available, and fuses ultimate portability with sleek looks and comfortable ergonomics to make for an eye-catching device that performs as great as it looks. These replacement Gen Air 40 refillable pods can hold up to 2ml of your favourite e-liquid and feature SSS leak-resistant technology to all but eliminate messy leaks, while the AOP (Adjustable Airflow On Pod) airflow control switch on the pod lets you seamlessly adjust the tightness or looseness of your draw to find the perfect vape experience for you. The Gen Air 40 pod is compatible with Vaporesso’s outstanding mesh GTX coil series for a variety of resistances that each offer a unique vape sensation and truly exquisite flavour production. The Vaporesso Gen 40 Air is ideal for use with high-PG , 50/50 and nicotine salts eliquids. Features 2ml Refillable Pods Compatible with Vaporesso GTX Mesh Coils SSS Leak resistant technology Adjustable Airflow Side-Filling
